object_description: slender long rectangular cube crowned by a rooftop sports terrace
design_condition: the narrow bar is pushed to the building line in the extension of the square, leaving an alley on one side and a spacious tree-lined playground on the other

positive: Slenderness gives the compact building elegance and frees plenty of open space at ground level
Alley and tree-lined playground offer added value to the neighbourhood
The orchard in front creates a recognisable, identity-forming prelude
The delicately fenced rooftop pitch works as a 90-metre pergola crowning the volume
Roof edge skilfully clad with a circumferential panel, meeting the design requirements
Two stairwells zone the building naturally so all uses can be separated and used individually
Cluster organisation fits astonishingly naturally into the narrow structure
Shallow building depth, high rooms and generous glazing give well-lit rooms of high quality
Compact cube with large photovoltaic roof is energy-efficient; good economic and ecological values
Modular structure offers great flexibility if usage requirements change
Despite its simple form the building creates outdoor spaces of outstanding quality
negative: The east staircase cylinder stands above the building line and is therefore not possible
The sequence of entrances and garland-shaped aprons is ambivalent
External expression should differentiate itself more from the surroundings and be developed from the interior spatial quality
